design.mechanism: outer-wrapper role operator over stable payload
design.unit: paired complete forms sharing renderer-stripped payload but differing in outer frame
design.contrast: wrapper selects a role/argument interpretation versus wrapper is orthographic notation around one invariant meaning
design.prediction: Across held paired forms, wrapper changes should predict a fixed change in edge/node or state/figure argument slot while the inner payload remains stable; unwrapped payload-only matching should not predict the role.
design.countermodel: Renderer stripping may discard semantically decisive material, or the shared payload may be a chance formal collision with no role relation.
design.falsifier: Independent role coding finds no reproducible wrapper-conditioned slot change across paired payloads, while payload-only and wrapper models tie.
design.principal_risk: The source explicitly reports proximity-only ownership and no semantic role binding.
design.related: Near GDT198 and IDEA000035/039, but narrows the proposition to an explicit wrapper-to-role operation rather than payload reuse, instrument/endpoint, or component identity.

source_evidence.quote:
Two of the three all-reading-stable figure-associated labels share the same
renderer-stripped HPR2 payload as one of the six tube-state labels:

| figure label | tube label | shared payload | surface change |
|---|---|---|---|
| `dotedy` (`f77r.8`) | `otedy` (`f77r.3`) | `e|NONE|DY1|B30` | add outer `d` wrapper |
| `otchdy` (`f77r.49`) | `dchdy` (`f77r.6`) | `ch|NONE|DY1|B30` | `d` wrapper versus `OT` frame |

The southwest figure label supplies a weaker third resemblance: ZL3b writes
`otolaiin | o`, while IT2a/RF1b join `otolaiino`; its initial `otol` equals the
fourth tube label, but the reading-dependent boundary prevents an exact
payload comparison.

This is a coherent local compiler pattern: opaque payload can remain stable
while its left rendering changes with visual label class.  It is not strong
enough to identify a role.  Across all 84 assignments of three figure roles to
the nine stable labels, 20 achieve at least the observed two cross-class
matches (**p=0.238095**).  Neither matched pair shares a complete surface or
full HPR2 tuple, and all human ownership is proximity-only.
